Q: How to create an online multi-user quiz A:

When I wanted to create an online multi-user quiz, I kept it simple. First, I chose an online quiz maker that supports sharing and real-time participation. Then I created the quiz questions, set a time limit, and enabled options like scores or leaderboards so multiple users could join and compete at the same time.

I usually use tools like Quizard for this because it works as both a quiz app and a free quiz maker, and it’s easy to share the quiz link with multiple users. Once everyone joins, they can attempt the quiz simultaneously, and results are shown instantly. This works well for classrooms, group practice, or fun competitions.
